subject.title: feat: add readiness conditions and providers

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `registerReadinessCriterion` and `gateway.readiness` as supported public SDK and operator configuration contracts, including opt-in fail-closed readiness behavior?
rationale: This is a new cross-boundary plugin API and configuration-driven serving-admission policy; implementation review cannot decide the permanent public contract, ownership, and upgrade expectations without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the readiness contract
options.body: Approve the public SDK and configuration direction, then require current-head fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to core-only readiness
options.body: Keep canonical core readiness internally but remove or defer plugin registration until a separately approved SDK contract exists.

options.title: Pause the feature proposal
options.body: Defer the readiness framework until the RFC and ownership model have an explicit maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the readiness contract
recommendation.body: Approve the public SDK and configuration direction, then require current-head fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history identifies this contributor as the current implementation contact, while the relevant current-main SDK owner is not identifiable from the available evidence.
